title: System Control Board, release 2c: the service cards' fixes
why: Decision 0171, release 2's folded-in cleanup fixes (Jason, 2026-11-18: 'clean up fixes that touch the system should move into the system board session'; 'go on 2c'). Five fixes, each closing a line of handoffs/control-board.md. (1) Requests waiting on outside companies get their own table, outside_requests, as the pre-flight keeps its results. They were squeezed into one short staff_settings value, and Name.com's ticket #3113488 never stayed (#84, #87, #89). Any kept the old way come over once with their ids, so their Pulse cases (outreq:<id>) stay; the ticket is seeded once; their answer closes one as before. The table is a record (staging-tables RECORDS). (2) The Stripe and Square cards read the names MarketPay reads. Live is the plain set (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY…, SQUARE_APP_ID…) with MARKET_PAY_ENV=live; the cards looked for STRIPE_LIVE_… / SQUARE_LIVE_…, which nothing uses, so a right live setup said 'keys missing'. Each card now names any missing setting, and also says whether test accounts' set (STRIPE_TEST_… / SQUARE_SANDBOX_…) is there. Staging already drops the live set, so nothing there changes. (3) The services added switched off on 2026-11-15 read 'until Release B and a person's switch'. B has shipped, so each says 'Off until a person switches it on' with its real reason: AZCC and NM SoS wait on our records requests, the licence lists on Cloudflare by hand. The seed uses the new words, and a data migration rewords the live rows that still hold the old words; a person's own reason stands. (4) /admin/crawler.php no longer tells you to set Railway's cron to */5: Start the system sets the schedule, and the page says to leave it and press Start the system on the board. (5) The crawler worker (2.12.1, deployed by Railway from git): a task stopped by a held service reports 'held', never 'failed', including the call that trips the hold, and Common Crawl's task checks its holds first. So a run whose only trouble is a held service ends ok on Railway, never Crashed. Tests: r2c.php 12, the worker's test_held_task.py 5 and all 8 of its other tests, r2b 14 and layout 8 still pass. FAQ: three new entries and one line.
